Machine GUIs

message.openblocks_reborn.book.catalog_w:
OpenBlocks Reborn Guide

This catalog contains all %s registered items. Entries are grouped into machines, world blocks, equipment, tools, components, and fluids. It also documents the three OpenBlocks enchantments.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.enchantme:
Flim Flam (I–IV)

Applies to weapons and armor. In player combat, the weapon level contests the target's armor protection; the weaker side accumulates bad luck that can later shuffle the hotbar, launch the player, inflict nausea and slowness, rename the held item, or teleport them nearby.

Unstable (I–III)

Applies to armor. Boots consume gunpowder after a fall over four blocks while not sneaking, creating an explosion, canceling fall damage, and launching the wearer upward. Enchanted helmets, chestplates, or leggings also explode when an entity hurts the wearer. Higher levels are stronger, and level III can break blocks.

Last Stand (I–III)

Applies to armor. When incoming damage would be fatal, enough total experience is consumed to cancel the hit and leave the wearer at one health. A higher combined enchantment level across the armor reduces the experience cost.
Blocks that process items or fluids, automate a task, or expose configurable input and output sides.
Place it in the world. Use it to open its controls; supply items, fluids, experience, or redstone as appropriate.
Construction, transport, utility, decoration, and interaction blocks used directly in the world.
Place this block in the world. Its special interaction is available by using, standing on, powering, or connecting it.
Items worn in an equipment slot or used while moving, sleeping, or gliding.
Equip this item in its appropriate armor slot or hold it while using its movement or resting ability.
Handheld tools for painting, inspection, linking, remote control, storage, and world interaction.
Use this item in hand. Sneak-use commonly selects a mode or opens configuration; its tooltip shows stored state.
Crafting parts, legacy migration items, and consumable materials.
This is primarily a crafting component or compatibility item rather than a standalone machine.
Containers used to move OpenBlocks fluids between the world and compatible machines.
Use it like a vanilla bucket: empty it into compatible tanks or the world and collect the fluid with an empty bucket.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.cr: Equip the Crane Backpack. Hold use to retract/raise, hold sneak-use to extend/lower, and left-click to grab or release. While held, the controller suppresses attacking, mining, and right-click interaction with targeted blocks or entities.
A chest-slot Crane assembly. Pair it with the Crane Control to operate its rendered arm, cable, and magnetic head.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.go: Sneak-use to search for a structure by name or ID. Locating runs on a dedicated background thread and binds when complete. Normal use points toward it, consuming durability without throwing the eye.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.im: Placed by Magic Pencils or Crayons. Only matching drawing tools reveal, select, and reshape these imaginary blocks.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.in: Catalogs every block, item, machine, tool, and fluid. It opens a Patchouli manual when available, otherwise a vanilla book.
patchouli.openblocks_reborn.book.landing: Welcome to the OpenBlocks Guide. This manual covers all 84 currently registered blocks, items, and fluid containers in six practical categories. Every entry introduces its basic use and includes a recipe page when a crafting recipe is available.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.la: An emerald trapdoor with vanilla-style opening and closing. Its open panel can also be climbed like a ladder.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.gu: Projects while powered. Side buttons adjust or copy six half-axes; top buttons rotate and select 11 shapes, and dyes recolor it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.bu: The powered Builder Guide places the next projected block per use. In creative, obsidian above it enables full-shape replacement.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.el: Links same-colored elevators in one vertical column. Jump to go up, sneak to go down, and dye it to select a channel.
Works like a normal Elevator, then rotates the arriving player to match the destination block's top arrow.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.he: Periodically restores health and a small amount of hunger and saturation to players standing on it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ta: Raises while powered. Projectile hits output a temporary redstone strength from 1 to 15 based on accuracy.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.gr: Stores up to 54 slots of a player's death drops. The owner can use the grave to recover all stored items.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.fl: A non-solid decorative flag that can stand on floors or hang on walls. Use dyes to recolor it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ta: Stores 16 B of fluid. Adjacent tanks connect and balance their contents, and vanilla buckets fill or drain them directly.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.tr: Displays a chosen mob trophy. Set its mob with a spawn egg, then use it empty-handed to play that mob's sound.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.be: Snaps shut on creatures, damaging and immobilizing them while emitting redstone. Use or power it to reset.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sp: Stores 1 B of water, applies water-like effects above it, and encourages crop growth. Bone meal boosts growth.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ca: Fires items from a 3x3 inventory on redstone. It shoots forward by default, or at a target bound with a Pointer.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.va: Collects nearby items and XP orbs into an inventory and 4 B XP tank. Its item and fluid output sides are configurable.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sp: Removes nearby fluid blocks when placed or used. It can be triggered repeatedly without becoming a wet sponge.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.bi: A stone oversized button. The total count in its eight slots sets its pulse duration from 1 to 512 ticks.
A wooden oversized button that arrows can trigger. Its eight-slot item count sets a 1 to 512 tick pulse.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.fa: Continuously pushes entities away from its front while powered. It supports horizontal, upward, and downward facing.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.xp: Combines glass bottles with liquid XP to make Bottles o' Enchanting, with configurable automatic item and fluid I/O.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.vi: Reports whether the current position is inside a village and visualizes nearby village bounds for building layouts.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pa: A very thin, non-colliding road laid on a solid top face. It drops itself if its supporting block is removed.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.au: Automates vanilla anvil repairing, combining, enchantment merging, and renaming with liquid XP and configurable I/O.
Automatically enchants with lapis and liquid XP. Its slider follows bookshelf power and modded enchantment limits.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.xp: Absorbs XP orbs and XP from players standing above it. It stores 1 B of liquid XP and outputs through its bottom.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.bl: Breaks the block in front on a redstone rising edge. Drops enter a container behind it, with overflow dropped nearby.
Places a block from its inventory directly in front when triggered. It supports horizontal, upward, and downward facing.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.it: Ejects stored items in any of six directions. Its UI controls speed and whether redstone strength scales the amount.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ro: Attaches to the clicked block face and consumes more ladders to extend downward. The hanging chain is climbable.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.do: A one-slot donation box for accepting and displaying contributed items in shared or public areas.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pa: Mixes a chosen RGB color from cyan, magenta, yellow, and black dyes, coloring brushes or paint cans after 300 ticks.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ca: Provides a 16x16 pixel grid on every face. Large tools affect a face, small tools affect one pixel, and stencils add patterns.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pa: Stores a custom RGB paint color. Brushes can sample it, and a Paint Mixer can recolor it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ca: A transparent Canvas with the same six 16x16 faces, large and small painting tools, and stencil support.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pr: Projects a 9x9 terrain shape from a Height Map. It can capture an Empty Height Map in place and rotate the projection.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.dr: Processes blank or existing stencils into a selected pattern, or outputs a selected Glyph using its page controls.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sk: Renders as the local sky while active but stays solid. Redstone controls it, and use toggles normal or inverted activation.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.xp: Stores 1 B of liquid XP and pulls it from the rear. While powered, it releases XP orbs beneath itself.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.go: Records its owner and hatches their sole Mini Me after about 30 seconds; another hatch replaces the old one. The owner can use it to toggle follow/stay, and the pair split either one's final damage and healing equally. Redstone quadruples hatching speed.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ha: Use while held to deploy. It slows falling, glides toward your view, and holds the player horizontally beneath the wing; sneak descends faster and flight consumes durability.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ge: A stackable generic item retained for legacy world and recipe compatibility. It currently has no direct active use.
An unstackable generic item retained for legacy world and recipe compatibility. It currently has no direct active use.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.lu: Deploys owner-following Luggage with 27 slots that collects nearby drops. Sneak-use it to pack it with contents preserved.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.so: Wear these in the helmet slot to highlight nearby creatures with a sonic electrical effect, even through darkness.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pe: Wear these to reveal and select imaginary blocks placed by the Magic Pencil so their shapes can be edited.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.cr: Wear these to reveal and select imaginary blocks matching the glasses' crayon color.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.te: Reveals every color of imaginary block while worn, without making all of them solid.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.se: Makes every imaginary block visible, selectable, and solid while worn, regardless of pencil or crayon color.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sl: Use it to test whether the current chunk is a slime chunk. Each test reports the result and consumes one durability.
Sleep in place at night without placing a block or changing your spawn point. Each use consumes durability.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pa: Loads color from an offhand dye or paint can. Use paints the aimed Canvas face; sneak-use paints every face.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sm: A pixel brush loaded from an offhand dye or paint can. It changes only the single Canvas pixel under the crosshair.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.st: Attach a Drawing Table pattern to a Canvas, then paint through it. Empty-hand use rotates it; sneak-use removes it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sq: Use removes paint from the aimed Canvas face; sneak-use clears every face. It also resets dyeable blocks to white.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sm: A pixel squeegee that removes only the single Canvas pixel under the crosshair.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.he: Stores surface heights for a 9x9 area. Use it to read the center terrain and biome, or insert it into a Projector.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.em: An uncaptured Height Map. A Cartographer or Projector can record a 9x9 terrain sample into it.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ca: Use while holding an Empty Height Map in the other hand to capture a 9x9 terrain sample at your position.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ta: An edible clay snack that restores a small amount of hunger and saturation.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.cu: Sneak-use a block face to bind it, then use it at any distance or across dimensions. Distance XP cost is capped at 1,024 blocks; unloaded targets are reported, not force-loaded.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.de: Configure it from the offhand to absorb matching pickups and void overflow. Sneak-use returns the stored stack.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sp: Use it on a block to drain nearby fluids. Durability is consumed only when fluid was actually removed.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.pe: Use it to report your total walking distance from player statistics, measured in blocks or meters.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ep: Removes lore from the offhand item. In the world it erases imaginary blocks or resets dyeable blocks to white.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.wr: Rotates supported facing or axis properties 90 degrees around the clicked face. Sneak-use buttons, levers, and chests; it rotates Guides.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.gl: Stores a selectable character. Use and sneak-use cycle it in opposite directions; use on a block hangs the glyph on its face.
A dedicated Hang Glider crafting component. Two wings are required for the completed glider.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.be: A structural Crane Backpack crafting component used to form its visible boom.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.cr: The Crane Backpack's engine component, assembled with its magnet, beams, and line.
A magnetic crafting component used by both the Crane Backpack and Miracle Magnet.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.mi: Attracts dropped items and XP orbs within eight blocks while in your inventory. Use it to toggle the effect.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.li: A Crane Backpack cable component used between its boom and magnetic head.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.ma: A control component combined with Map Memory to craft an Empty Height Map.
A storage component combined with a Map Controller to craft an Empty Height Map.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.as: The core base component used to craft the handheld Cartographer.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.un: A blank stencil stock. Process it in a Drawing Table to select a pattern that can be attached to Canvas.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.sk: A dedicated crafting component used to make the Drawing Table.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.po: Use it first on a Cannon, then on a target block in the same dimension to bind aimed deliveries.
message.openblocks_reborn.book.detail.xp: A bucket containing 1 B of liquid XP with vanilla bucket priority. It fills XP machines or tanks and can place the fluid.
